Lower Text: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When one of your Digimon with [D-Brigade] in its traits attacks, reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. You may play 1 [Commandramon] among them without paying the cost. Trash the rest.
Upper Text: [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may play 1 Digimon card with [D-Brigade] in its traits and a play cost of 5 or less among them without paying the cost. Trash the rest.
